label: sparse copy-phase update unit, weakly tied to input p (no clean rule)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (100% of mass), only at recall_idx >= 2, and only on repeat (in_first == 0) inputs. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. It is enriched for long sequences (L=9 holds 62% of mass, with peaks at t=12, 13 and the final step t=17) and for L=3 at its last step t=5. Input p is the strongest token (11x lift, 39% of mass), followed by f and r, and the top activations are mostly the final copy step with input p or r. Even so, every predicate tried has precision below 0.25 (the best F1 is about 0.17): it is silent on most steps matching any position or token condition, so what triggers it is some sparse combination not captured by these variables. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.008) and only weakly higher at the final copy step.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=13: p, f, r, z; t=10: p, r, h, f; t=12: p, f, j, r) and the next token to output (most: c, t, q, e, x, y; least: f, n, p, k); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=4 & t=6, L=3.
